full_judgment:
2. The facts, in short, are that the respondent Nos. 1 and 2 as plaintiffs filed Title Suit No. 21 of 2008 for partition and for buying up under Section 4 of the Partition Act stating, inter-alia, that Romani Mohon was the owner of 4.881/2 acres of land who died living 6 sons plaintiff Nos. 1 and 2, defendant Nos. 8,9, 10 and Noyan Krishna Paul. Each sons got 811/2 acre of land. Defendant Nos. 5 and 7 transferred .60 acre of land in favour of defendant Nos. 12-15 on 08.05.2008 including the building and other lands. They are muslims and there was no partition by metes and bounds among the co-sharers. Defendant Nos. 12-15 did not get any possession of the land. Hence the plaintiffs filed the suit. 

 3. The plaintiffs filed an application for temporary injunction under Order 39 Rules 1 and 2 of the Code of Civil Procedure against: the defendant Nos. 12-. 15 praying for temporary injunction restraining the defendant Nos. 12-15 froth entering into the suit land and also restraining them from performing their religious function till disposal of the suit. 

 4. The defendant Nos. 12-15 contested the suit by filing a written objection contending, inter-alia, that the plaintiffs have no cause of action and the injunction application is vague and unspecified and their specific case is that the defendant Nos. 5-7 are the brothers of the plaintiffs. Within the full knowledge of the plaintiffs, the defendant Nos. 5 and 7 transferred .60 acre of land in favour of defendant Nos. 12-15 and delivered possession in favour of them including the building and the defendant Nos. 12-15 have been possessing the same as homestead and also by way of cultivation. Further large numbers of muslim families are also living within the boundaries of the suit land. The balance of convenience and inconvenience is in favour of the defendants and the plaintiffs have no prima-facie case, besides the suit land is totally unspecified. The plaintiff claimed only 1.63 acre of land out of 4.881/2 acres but the land is not specified in the application for temporary injunction. Hence the application for temporary injunction is liable to be rejected.
